task_selection: Manual diversity selection; no random task draw and no task-selection seed.
prospective_scope: Four added PPO tasks and the five-task portfolio were fixed before their new50-case native/Flora outcomes. OpenDrawer and PPO-held-out CloseFridge had earlier pilot measurements; this is not a fully outcome-naive portfolio.
purpose_of_seeds: Native constructor/layout seed banks and separate motor/residual/update RNGs make episode and policy sampling reproducible. They did not randomly select tasks.
inference_limit: Development subset, not an unbiased random sample of RoboCasa365. OOD is relative to PPO exposure; all ten tasks have documented atomic_seen pretraining entries.
change_authorization: The human question about random selection does not authorize a new task draw, a replacement or a changed gate. Original manifest is preserved.
